entries.name: Basic angling licence
entries.regs_verbatim: If you are 16 years of age or older, you must have a valid basic licence to sport fish for any species of fish in non-tidal waters. Basic and supplementary licences and stamps are not valid in National Parks. If you are under 16 and a resident of B.C., you may sport fish without any licence or stamp and you are entitled to your own quota of fish. If you are under 16 and not a resident of B.C., you do not require any licence or stamp to sport fish, but you must be accompanied by a person 16 years or older who holds the appropriate licences and stamps, and any fish you keep must be counted as part of the catch and possession of your accompanying licence holder. If you are an Indian and a resident of B.C., you are not required to obtain any type of fishing licence or stamp to sport fish in non-tidal waters. All Metis individuals intending to sport fish in non-tidal waters are required to hold appropriate angling licences and stamps. You must have a valid basic licence to sport fish for any species of fish in non-tidal waters (including salmon). ### If you are under 16 and a resident of B. Métis: all Métis individuals intending to sport fish in non-tidal waters are required, under the Wildlife Act, to hold appropriate angling licences and stamps.
